  Information Security Management [IT-5021]

  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           With a neat block diagram demonstrate NSTISSC Security Model.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Differentiate between Vulnerability and exposure.                                      (3)  
  C)      Discuss Trojan horse attacks on software.                                              (2)  
  2)           Describe different stages of Risk Assessment.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      What is Biba Model and where it is used?                                               (3)  
  C)      What is phishing? Give an example.                                                     (2)  
  3)           Demonstrate Chinese wall security model with neat diagram.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Illustrate with an example how access is granted by an access control matrix.          (3)  
  C)      Discuss cross site scripting Vulnerabilities.                                          (2)  
  4)           Discuss the uses of Bell-Lapadula Model.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Illustrate the difference between Quantitative versus Qualitative Risk Management  
  Practices.                                                                             (3)  
  
  C)      Explain Risk Appetite and Residual Risk.                                               (2)  
  5)           Briefly Explain the concepts of Key information Security Concepts..                    (5)
